title: Beltsand Tunnel
safeHtml:
Beltsand Tunnel is an underwater tunnel in NR Los Sengas Division.

Description[]

  • Number of Tubes: 2
  • Length: 3567 m
  • Lines Served: Delta Line
  • Location: Ponsand Island - Belt Island Station

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • At over 3 km long, this underwater tunnel broke the record of Comp Ward North Tunnel and became the longest underwater tunnel in Los Sengas. However, this record was promptly broken by Purple Gate Tunnel.

Birdlet Tunnel is an underwater tunnel in NR Los Sengas Division.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is now the only station in Los Sengas that did not belong to any District.
  • This Station shares many similarities with Arrowhead Station with the regards that both stations are situated on the tip of a newly discovered continent, and both stations involve the use of red and black building materials, with the Elevated Platforms using Side Platforms and the Underground Platforms using Island Platforms. However, unlike in Arrowhead Station, where the east-west oriented platforms are located underground, the East-West oriented platforms are elevated.

History[]

  • December 10 2022: This station completed construction.[2]
  • December 12 2022: This station began services. Stadow Line and Pegasus Line extends from Hawthorn Station and Trisob Bay Station respectively to this station.

Blackstone Village Station is a station on Stadium Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Clouds. Passengers may also use this station to change to Shimizu Railway Southam Line (Blackstone Village Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is currently the easternmost station in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This Station is the first station to be located to the east of Intus Orient (X = +20000).
  • This Station has defined the design of rural stations in Nazca Railway:[3]
    • Using Ground Section tracks and gravel tracks (In the style of East Ring Line) whenever possible.
    • Longer distances between stations.
    • Simpler designs of Stations
    • Side Platforms
    • Sidings in Stations
  • A similar Station design would later be seen at Lower Shack Station.
  • This Station is Sister Stations with Whitestone Village Station.

History[]

  • April 27 2020: This station began services.

  • Stars: 0

Fun Facts[]

  • The platform layout of this station pays tribute to the original track layout of Admin Station in Terracept Division, both of which involves three platforms, with one of them having plans to connect to a depot. However, while the depot near Admin Station was eventually demolished due to changes in development plans, the depot tracks of this station managed to connect to Centopia Depot to the south, four years and ten months after the completion of this station.[3]
  • The design of this station pays tribute to the concourse of Well Come Cliff Station in Terracept Division.
  • The Station Souvenir of this station is not official.
  • Centopia, or the future Nazca Railway Headquarters, is located two kilometers directly to the south of this station on a pill-shaped artificial island.
  • The bridge support pillars to the south of this station contains blocks of gold and blocks of quartz, an indicator that the trains are approaching or leaving Centopia from its north. However, the bridge support pillars to the south of Platform 3 (Centopia Depot) are normal bridge pillars.

History[]

  • September 7 2015: This station began services.
  • August 6 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • June 17 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • July 15 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.
  • July 17 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Resplendence of Eons.
  • This Stations features The Cuisine, and the Station Menu is "Blue Crab Gumbo with Okra and Herb Rice".
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Particles and Pinnacles".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Resplendence of Eons 03:54
Sediment of Passing Ages 02:30

Fun Facts[]

  • Despite being an elevated station, the platforms of this station are completely sealed off.
  • This Station, coupled with Upson Opens Station, alludes to the word Vicissitudes in Chinese.
  • While this station has water above the ceiling of the platforms and the concourse so that the concourse and the platform are visible with each other, Upson Opens Station has water on the floor in the middle of the Platform, as well as a skylight above the platform.
  • Upson Opens Station uses blue concrete to allude to Iceland as ice is usually associated with the color blue, whereas this station, despite its name, uses Green Concrete to allude to Greenland. [3]
  • While the Exits and the Platforms are at the same altitude of Y=70, as the Platforms are situated above a canal, this Station is considered an Elevated Station.
  • Reserved connecting tracks for the Dusty Depot are seen to the north of this station.
  • A pane of glass exists at the sides of the concourse to see the Abyss Line tracks. However, it should also be noted that passengers riding on Abyss Line can see the concourse through the same pane of glass.

History[]

  • April 7 2018: This Station began services alongside Abyss Line.
  • March 31 2025: The Station Title of this station is announced through the monthly calender.[4]
  • October 21 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]
  • May 30 2026: The Station Cuisine of this station is added. At the same day, this Station began expansion of the Daybreaker Line Part.
  • June 1 2026: This station completed expansion of the Daybreaker Line Part.
  • June 2 2026: Daybreaker Line extends from Mansgrove Station to this station.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Nebular Leviathans.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "From Abyss to Aether".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Nebular Leviathans 02:27

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first station to feature "Station Icons". Station Icons are icons that correspond to the Station Title of the station, and are divided into the Bright and Dark Color Scheme versions. They would also appear on the vertical station banners and the concourse of each station.
  • This Station features a station park with a lake whose shape resembles a whale. This lake would also go on to become the namesake of the island on which this station is located. However, as the Station Park is sub-contracted to other players, it is currently under construction.
  • This station is the only station on Luxter Line that does NOT feature any interchanges with other Nazca Railway Lines and Co-Op Railway Lines. The other stations in Luxter Line between Bufly Island and Mangkhut Sound are as follows:

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is named after a road nearby due to the fact that the road sticks to the mountain feet and caused the road to have a lot of curves.
  • Due to geological limitations, the Daring Line Platforms and Glinstrouß Line Platforms are only connected by an elevator, and most of the transfer is conducted through the concourse.

History[]

  • June 18 2020: Nazca Railway has announced the destinations of Exits A-D of this station.[2]
  • June 19 2020: This station began services alongside Daring Line.
  • June 6 2021: Exit E is added to this station.[3]
  • July 14 2021: The Glinstrouß Line part of this station began extension.
  • July 16 2021: The Glinstrouß Line platforms and concourse part of this station completed expansion. At the same day, Glinstrouß Line is established.

Bonyal is one of the Sub-Districts of Downtown districts, near itswestern and southern borders. It is situated at the boundary of Los Sengas Continent with West Metropolis Archipelago. To the north of this sub-district is Threeler. This Sub-District also features the Metropolis Pier services.

Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 2
  • Two Players are required.
  • Similar to the Metro River Station Gauntlet, Your foothold is the most important part of the solution.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of a Lava Bucket.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station was formerly the station with the most exits besides of Metropolis Terminal at 16 Exits, but after S3E14P2, this record has been broken by Tin Kam Station of Glinstrouß Line and Everchord Line at 28 Exits.[6] Despite this, however, it still held the record of having the most exits in any Single-line Station until the arrival of Phoenix Line to this station at S3E19. With that being said, the addition of Exit H after the Phoenix Line expansion meant that this station is still the station with the third most exits at 17 Exits, exceeding Lens Station at 16 Exits.

History[]

  • May 21 2015: This station began services alongside Arcgo Line.
  • May 6 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[7]
  • July 10 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[8]
  • August 28 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[9]
  • April 7 2023: This station began expansion.
  • April 13 2023: This station completed expansion.
  • April 14 2023: Phoenix Line extends from Sincerity Cove Station to this station.
  • September 8 2023: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Make good observations. Only one of the passageways lead to the Station Souvenir.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a clock.

Station Gauntlet Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1.5
  • Four players are required to get this Station Gauntlet Souvenir, and each player must sprint to the end of their respective track and press a button to open up the next track.
  • The Station Gauntlet Souvenir comes in the form of Rabbit's Foot.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after Bonyal Estate, the first public housing project in Los Sengas.

History[]

  • April 25 2015: This station began services.
  • March 5 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • January 13 2017: This station completed replacement of direction and platform signs.[3]
  • June 4 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • February 26 2022: Exit F is added to this station to connect to Pegasus Line, Phoenix Line Sincerity Cove Station.
  • May 11 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]
  • July 28 2022: The "Station Gauntlet" of this station is set up.[6]

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station does NOT feautre platform passageways at the Platform Levels.
  • The Design of Exit A1 of this station takes reference from Exits B and C of Wilde Street Station, which in turn adopts the New York City Subway exit design.
  • Unlike Bonyal Estate Station and Bonyal Bay Station, which also starts with the word Bonyal, this station does not use the Yellow Color in its livery.
  • Despite the station being named Bonyal North, this station is actually located in the easternmost part of Vayler development area.
  • While this station is close to SLT Line 104 Okayama Street and Shizuoka Street Stops, there are no connecting pathways between them.

History[]

  • April 16 2023: This Station began construction.
  • April 22 2023: This Station completed construction.
  • April 23 2023: Phoenix Line extends from Bonyal Bay Station to Vayler North Station through this station.

History[]

  • August 3 2017: This station completed construction, which is also the first station of Metro Express Transport in the Los Sengas Railway Cooperation Scheme.
  • April 26 2019: This station started rebuilding works and ceased service. All Leanpool Line trains terminated at Lean Forest North.
  • May 1 2019: The station completed its rebuilding works and service was resumed. Additionally, a testing stage "MXT Cart-calling System ver0" was installed on Platform 1.
  • July 6 2023: This station began expansion works for the West Metropolis Line.
  • February 29 2024: The West Metropolis Line expansion of this station is completed. West Metropolis Line is established.

title: Borderers Park Stabling Sidings
safeHtml:
Borderers Park Stabling Sidings is one of the stabling sidings of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division constructed for Cometsilk Line and Kilo Line. It is located in the underground between Nail Bight Checkpoint and Milky Realm Station. This Stabling Siding is designed to support the train flow needed for Cometsilk Line and Kilo Line, and is estimated to have a capacity of up to eight 9-carriage trains.

Contents

  • 1 Description
    • 1.1 Sidings
    • 1.2 Connecting Tracks
  • 2 Fun Facts
  • 3 Gallery
  • 4 Citations and References

Description[]

Sidings[]

The two sides have four sidings each, which can store eight trains.

Connecting Tracks[]

The northern end of the stabling sidings connect to Kilo Line, with access to Nail Bight Checkpoint, while the southern end of the stabling sidings connect to Cometsilk Line, with access to Milky Realm Station.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Stabling Sidings is named after the Borderers Park above it, and is the second Nazca Railway siding which is NOT named based on an existing station, with the first one being Sava North Stabling Sidings.
  • This Stabling Sidings is completed with the construction of the Kilo Line tracks between Nail Bight Checkpoint and Spring Point Gateway.
  • Before the completion of this Stabling Sidings, Kilo Line is independent from the whole network of Nazca Railway. After the completion, the Kilo Line tracks are able to connect to the tracks of Cometsilk Line via this sidings, thus connecting to the whole network.

Fun Facts[]

  • The name and design of this station corresponds to the Bottom Quark, one of the six types of Quarks. To correspond to the elements of "Bottom", the following elements are incorporated:
    • Nether Bricks are used for this station and is placed at the bottom of each pillar.[2] This station is the second station after Flamelute Island Station to make use of Nether Bricks.
    • Darker color schemes are used at this station as sunlight is harder to reach bottoms of the sea than the tops of the sea.
    • This station has the lower altitude of platforms among the Quark-themed stations of Oasis Bay Line.
  • While the Platforms is located at Y=60 and is considered underground in a stricter sense, as some places with a lower floor height might also have grounds at Y=60, this station is considered a ground station.[3]
  • A small section of Oceanfloor Tubes exist to the south of this station for trains heading for Strange Channel Station.

History[]

  • January 24 2020: This station began services.
  • June 5 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the first and currently the only station in Los Sengas Division which only has one platform and serves as the permanent downward terminus of a Line.
  • This station is the first station to be built at West Metropolis Archipelago in Season 2.
  • The blue wool, light blue wool and white wool of this station alludes to Four Rhythms Across the Blue, a Japanese adult visual novel released in 2014. Four character pillars are constructed at the concourse of the station that corresponds to the four main characters of that visual novel. Their buildling materials, and their corresponding characters, are listed as follows from west to east. It should however be noticed that all character pillars contain white stained glass, Quartz Stairs and Quartz Slabs at the top, with Pillar Quartz Blocks at the center of each pillar:
    • Light Blue Stained Glass Pane, Smooth Sandstone - Mashiro Arisaka
    • Pink Stained Glass Pane, Pink Terracotta - Asuka Kurashina
    • Yellow Stained Glass Pane, Black Wool - Misaki Tobisawa
    • Cyan Stained Glass Pane, Purpur Block - Rika Ichinose

  • June 25 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is named after a river whose shape resembles a bow. However, the river has since disappeared due to development in the surrounding area.
  • The Station Park has a 20m shooting range and a 40m shooting range. The 30m Shooting Range is located at Apperit Station, which is also bow-themed.

  • March 9 2020: This station began services.
  • September 24 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[2]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Sly Sentinels.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Gleams Between the Rails".

Fun Facts[]

  • This station alludes to City One Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.[2]
  • This is the first station to be named after a Punctuation Mark, with the name of this station being an amalgam of Bracket and Fox.

History[]

  • July 13 2016: This Station began services.
  • October 13 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • March 9 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • February 7 2024: The Platforms of this station are extended from 152m to 204m.
  • November 4 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]
  • March 2 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]

Fun Facts[]

  • This station began services at the 20th birthday of the builder of Nazca Railway, and is hence seen as a birthday station.
  • The concourse is shaped like a human brain. However, while the east side of the concourse features colored wool, the west side of the concourse features bookshelves and enchantment tables. This corresponds to the common belief that the right brain and the left brain corresponds to the artistic side and the logical side of the human brain.[2][3]

History[]

  • October 27 2015: This station began services.
  • September 7 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • April 5 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • April 5 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

Fun Facts[]

  • When this station was constructed, the Station Number of Aquilo Circuit was reserved as 40-03. However, due to the changes in development plans, the Station Number ultimately became 40-04. The original Station Number of this station has since been used by Clovefront Station.
  • Exits A and B of this station feature large-scaled Exit Banners in a fashion similar to Pinestand Station, Apple Hill Station and Summer Point Gateway.

History[]

  • February 22 2023: This Station began construction.[4]
  • February 26 2023: This Station completed construction.[5]
  • February 28 2023: Snowty Line is established.
  • April 8 2025: This Station completed setting up of Aquilo Circuit systems.[6]
  • May 16 2025: Aquilo Circuit extends from Greenbay Crest Station to this station through Clovefront Station.

title: Branches' Hallow Tunnel
safeHtml:
Branches' Hallow Tunnel is an underwater tunnel in NR Los Sengas Division.

Description[]

  • Number of Tubes: 4
  • Length: 1787 m
  • Lines Served: Snowty Line, Mike Line
  • Location: Intus Aquilo Gateway - Branches' Hallow Station

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • This tunnel is the first underwater tunnel used by Snowty Line and Mike Line.
